scope: Anonymous independent product-output review only; no implementation or publication.
attention: Same main scenarios, focused follow-up, reduced-motion checks at both sizes, and keyboard failure probes for all three variants.
overall: All variants completed tested local note tasks with preserved drafts, saved data, retry and collection identity. Differences concern composition, preview content, spatial transition and focus/cancellation behavior; no universal ranking inferred.

executed_checks.result: All variants showed honest empty collections and created test notes through UI.
479-character mixed note, 52-character English note and 27-character Chinese note were saved/reopened; 779-character input retained with Save disabled.
Draft text preserved through light/dark and English/Chinese UI changes.
Fixed card-space bounds; saved content populated; tested text selection and inner scroll restored.
Three Ctrl+Enter requests did not duplicate record; rapid flip and route switching ended at requested card/content.
Submitted version stored while newer input remained a front-face draft with explicit feedback.
Three cards retained separate identity, drafts, current-tile focus, and narrow return scroll.
Injected first-save/update Storage exceptions retained draft and prior storage; recovery through retry succeeded.
Injected read error blocked creation and exposed retry; retry recovered all three records.
Save shortcut, selected-range restoration, tile Enter activation, Tab samples and failed-save focused activation executed at both viewports.
No 3D rotation in the tested reduced contexts; correct faces, save/reverse/collection return and sampled Tab path at both sizes.
01 confirmation dismissed with three records intact; 02 immediate clear-all left zero; 03 immediate current-note clear left two.
Initial editor and saved face captured at desktop; initial saved endpoints visually compared with final.

variants.composition: Persistent intro plus right-hand two-column collection; independent title and body excerpt. Desktop card 714×474; narrow 354×456.
variants.type_material: Serif heading/read face, sans-serif body editor; pale badge, rounded paper, broad static footprint/shadow. Desktop textarea client height 130 px.
variants.motion: Stable-axis front/back turn; prepared editor fades in on collection opening; immediate collection return in samples.
variants.continuity: Draft/storage/focus-range/scroll retained; failed keyboard Save keeps Save focused; read retry transfers focus to New note.
consequential_differences: Independent editable title gives explicit note identity.
Two-column collection beside intro uses a second row for three cards.
Collection opening fades rather than travelling from tile position.
Clear-all has a dismissible native confirmation.

variants.composition: Full-width three-column collection with first-line title, count and status; fixed research context beside editor. Desktop card 662×462; narrow 350×364.
variants.type_material: Serif editor/read content; larger boxed editor, circular mark, rounded card and diffuse lower shadow. Desktop textarea client height 222 px.
variants.motion: Selected preview enlarges into editor and saved card shrinks back; old preview content remains visible during intermediate opening samples.
variants.continuity: Data and tested range/scroll retained; failed keyboard Save and successful collection read retry leave BODY focused.
consequential_differences: First-line/count tiles expose less body context than excerpts.
Spatial collection path maintains selected slot orientation.
Retained research question places narrow editor lower on page.
Clear-all immediately removes all notes without confirmation.

reproduced_gaps.severity_description: Limited keyboard continuity gap; retry remains reachable.
reproduced_gaps.reproduction: Fresh note with 52-character archive text; make Storage.setItem throw QuotaExceededError; focus Save; press Enter; wait 1200 ms.
reproduced_gaps.observed: Focus becomes BODY; next Tab reaches retry. Draft remains; no success turn.

variants.composition: Full-width three-column collection with large body excerpts and explicit count/local-draft boundary; fixed research context beside narrower editor. Desktop card 570×466; narrow 350×390.
variants.type_material: Serif text with fine editor rules, restrained corners, star/check motif, lower cast shadow, saved timestamp and shortcut hint. Desktop textarea client height 205 px.
variants.motion: Prepared destination editor scales from source tile region; collection tile scales down on return. Text/control shapes visibly scale during the sampled morph.
variants.continuity: Data and tested range/scroll retained; failed keyboard Save and successful collection read retry leave BODY focused.
consequential_differences: Larger body excerpts aid content recognition but clamp long notes and collapse line breaks.
Prepared destination content is visible from early spatial-transition samples.
Failure retry sits at lower narrow viewport edge.
Clear control immediately removes only current note, without confirmation.

reproduced_gaps.severity_description: Limited keyboard continuity gap; retry remains reachable.
reproduced_gaps.reproduction: Fresh note with 52-character archive text; make Storage.setItem throw QuotaExceededError; focus Save; press Enter; wait 1200 ms.
reproduced_gaps.observed: Focus becomes BODY; Tab reaches All notes and then retry. Draft remains; no success turn.

tooling_failures.description: Test virtualenv lacked Pillow for contact-sheet construction; used available environment Python/Pillow after retaining failure. No app source repair.

rejected_suspicions.description: Reduced-mode header disappearance was not in saved pixels; header crops exactly match normal capture and stable fresh-context screenshots show it.

unobserved_dimensions: Physical target-device smoothness and continuous playback
Screen-reader announcements and exhaustive focus traversal
Simultaneous tabs and external storage mutation
Genuine quota/full-disk exhaustion instead of injected exceptions
Live reduced-preference change during an active turn
Full initial-version regression and initial narrow views
Full theme/locale/motion/failure combination matrix; reduced-motion desktop dark mode
motion_evidence_limit: Only sampled frames viewed. Capture timings include overhead; actual elapsed times retained. No target-device smoothness claim.
